ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High; predominantly high-intensity white pixels covering approximately 85% of the visible surface, contrasted by low-intensity black pixels along the trailing edge boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white region in central and proximal fluke. Irregular black pigmentation band (width variable, 5-15% of lobe height) along the entire trailing edge. Scattered small dark-pixel focal spots in the lower-right and lower-left lobe quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; interior angle approximately 35-45 degrees; vertex depth is significant relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extensive high-frequency serrations along the trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks increases significantly at the lateral tips, creating a highly irregular, jagged boundary appearance.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slightly convex sweep trajectory from the central notch to the tips, with a distinct upward curvature at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, roughly circular high-contrast clusters localized at both the extreme left and right tips, interrupting the black pigmentation boundary.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible low-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) on the right lobe, oriented diagonally towards the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular erosion and material loss on the outer tips; presence of protruding, textured circular colonies at the lateral extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Discrete, shallow circular indentations distributed across the white ventral surface, visible as localized low-intensity grey gradients.
